navDescriptor: Every edit by every team, checked against the brand.

seo.title: QA agents for in-house web and brand teams | Superflow
seo.description: Fifty editors publish every day. Agents check every change against the brand guide, the legal lines and WCAG. Each team sees its own findings. SSO and SCIM on Enterprise.

hero.h1: Fifty editors. One brand. Every page checked.
hero.sub: Agents check every change against the brand guide, the legal lines and WCAG. Your team decides what to fix. Each team sees its own findings.
hero.clientLine: The brand lead taps Approve on the fixes before the campaign goes live.

pack.name: Brand Site Agent Pack
pack.intro: Eight agents for a site many teams edit. Every change, with findings routed to the team that owns the page.

agents.name: Palette Guard
agents.checks: Checks every color on the page against the brand guide.
agents.finding: Careers page button uses #2F80ED. The guide allows #1E5BB8.

agents.name: Font Guard
agents.checks: Checks every font on the page against the brand guide.
agents.finding: Press page body text is Georgia. The guide allows Inter only.

agents.name: Tone Check
agents.checks: Reads copy against the voice guide: banned words, claims, tone.
agents.finding: Press page uses 'best-in-class'. The voice guide bans it.

agents.name: Legal Lines
agents.checks: Checks required disclaimers and trademark lines on every page.
agents.finding: Pricing page is missing the 'prices vary by region' line.

agents.name: Broken Links
agents.checks: Follows every link on every page and flags the ones that fail.

agents.name: Meta Titles
agents.checks: Checks every page has a unique, specific title.

agents.name: Accessibility
agents.checks: Checks contrast, alt text, headings and form labels.
agents.finding: 41 images under /blog have no alt text.

agents.name: Consistency Checker
agents.checks: Finds spacing and components drifting across pages.

buildYourOwn.input: Flag any page that still shows the old logo.
buildYourOwn.finding: The old logo appears on 11 pages, all under /blog.

agentsCheck: Every page uses the brand's colors and fonts.
Every page carries the legal lines.
youDecide: What gets fixed before the campaign.
When a page needs a redesign, not a fix.

faq.q: Can different teams get different findings?
faq.a: Yes. Assign findings by section or by page. Each team sees its own.
Yes. Agents check pages behind Okta and other SSO. Your team signs in with SSO on Enterprise.

faq.q: Can we keep data in our region?
faq.a: Yes. Enterprise plans offer data residency options.
